statement: RAG-based commercial legal research tools still hallucinate in 17-33% of queries despite retrieval augmentation, confirming that retrieval-side reliability in legal QA remains an open problem rather than a solved one.

evidence.quote: the AI research tools made by LexisNexis (Lexis+ AI) and Thomson Reuters (Westlaw AI-Assisted Research and Ask Practical Law AI) each hallucinate between 17% and 33% of the time
